A clear editorial seam at segments 20-29: a hortatory bridge ('Behold, I have raised you up') introduces an ecclesial application about Elect and catechumens who pray, drawing the cosmic three-prayer pattern into contemporary church practice. Segment 30 returns to substrate ('those who prayed the Father concerning the Ambassador'), and 31-34 continue the substrate teaching of the third prayer / icon-revealing. The fatigue score (+4.63) accurately flags the late-page drift toward ecclesial/hortatory material.
